simulation_brief.summary: Awards-race initialization focused on whether fictionalized contender nominee_s wins Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards. Source text indicates nominee_s has the most nominations and strong cultural conversation, while other nominees better match historical Academy preferences. Preferential ballot dynamics create uncertainty by rewarding broad consensus over intense first-place support. Terminal resolution depends only on the official Best Picture announcement.
simulation_brief.terminal_condition: nominee_s is officially announced as Best Picture winner
uncertainty_notes: Specific competing film identities are not provided beyond a prestige-drama rival archetype.
No quantitative precursor data such as guild wins, critics awards, or voting blocs is provided.
Scenario is endpoint-focused; many social and institutional details must remain abstract.
